assumptions: Audio consumes read-only scale, selection and presentation projections supplied by the integration owner.
Audio is optional presentation and is never required to navigate, select, inspect or preserve state.
limitations: All cues are presentation-only and do not establish scientific, historical, biological or environmental evidence.
Vacuum regimes never present environmental audio as literal propagating sound; only explicitly non-diegetic sonification may remain.
Physical-device acoustic output and platform-specific latency are not verified by the lane-local deterministic harness.

fidelity.validity: Read-only contextual mapping from admitted scale/scene/environment presentation context into optional procedural audio.
fidelity.resolution: At most six simultaneous presentation layers with one AudioContext and bounded nodes.
fidelity.uncertainty: Mappings are qualitative product sonification and intentionally non-evidentiary.
